title: Points service — award and deduct points based on events
description: Create a reusable points service that inserts a record into points_log, updates projects.points_total, and triggers level recalculation.
acceptanceCriteria: awardPoints(projectId, delta, reason, source) function exists
Handles negative delta (deductions) correctly — points_total never goes below 0

steps.details: Create server/src/services/pointsService.ts. Export async function awardPoints(projectId: string, delta: number, reason: string, source: PointSource). 1) Fetch current points_total. 2) Compute newTotal = Math.max(0, current + delta). 3) In a transaction: a) INSERT into points_log (projectId, delta, reason, source). b) UPDATE projects SET points_total = newTotal WHERE id = projectId. 4) Call recalculateLevel(projectId, newTotal). 5) Log timeline event 'points_change' with { delta, reason, newTotal }.

Create project, call awardPoints(id, 10, 'test', 'manual'). Verify points_total = 10 in DB. Call awardPoints(id, -50, 'test deduct', 'manual'). Verify points_total = 0 (not -40). Check points_log has both entries.
